codeSnippets.output: The card lifts 6px smoothly on hover.

exercise.instruction: Style the card: .avatar should be 96px, perfectly round, with object-fit cover. .card-body should be a centered column (flex, column, align-items center, padding 24px). Add a hover transition that lifts the card 6px with 0.3s ease.
exercise.starterCode:
Aria Chen

Frontend Developer

React CSS JS
hints: Hint 1: .avatar { width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; }
Hint 2: .card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 24px; }
Hint 3: The hover lift is already started — the transition is already on .card.

quiz.question: What does object-fit: cover do?
options: Crops the image to fill the box

quiz.question: Why use overflow: hidden on the card?
options: To keep rounded corners clipping the content
